# TruWave TV

> TruWave TV is a licensed IPTV subscription service offering live TV channels (Sports, News, Documentaries, Kids, Local) plus a small, specifically licensed library of Movies & TV Shows (VOD), in 4K and Full HD, with a free 24-hour trial, AntiFreeze Technology for stable streaming, a TV Guide (EPG), 24/7 WhatsApp support, worldwide access, and a pay-only-after-confirmed-working model. Plans range from 1 to 12 months, supporting 1-5 simultaneous devices (more available on request).

## Key pages

- [Home](https://truwavetv.com/): overview, channel categories, pricing, FAQ
- [Pricing](https://truwavetv.com/#pricing): plans (1/3/6/12 months), multi-device pricing
- [Apps](https://truwavetv.com/apps/): comparison of compatible player apps (TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, GSE Smart IPTV, IBO Player, OTT Navigator)
- [Blog](https://truwavetv.com/blog/): setup guides, troubleshooting, and buyer's guides
